gaps.explanation: Statement p4 (Statement of Receipts, Disbursements, and Changes in Fund Balances - Cash Basis - Governmental Funds): Road Fund Local 5,402 under receipts and Sale of surplus 3,842 under Other Financing Sources; Total Receipts 4,350,150. The Road Fund Budgetary Comparison Schedule (p9) prints Local 9,244 (= 5,402 + 3,842) inside its receipts (Total Receipts 968,321 vs statement Road Fund 964,479) and has no other-financing line for the sale of surplus. So the schedule counts the 3,842 sale of surplus as a receipt while the statement shows it as other financing: schedule 4,353,992 - 4,350,150 = 3,842. The schedule prints no breakdown of Local 9,244, so the printed line stays; no fix.
